info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Product Service Agency API
info.description: The Product Service Agency API provides seamless access to product information managed by external banking agencies. Typical consumers include financial institutions and application developers looking to integrate product offerings into their services. This API allows users to retrieve detailed product descriptions, pricing, and availability by querying with specific parameters. The endpoint is designed to enhance collaboration among partners and streamline product data dissemination, ultimately improving user experience and decision-making.

get.description: This endpoint retrieves the details of a specific product service agency using its unique identifier. It is designed to provide comprehensive information about the agency for external users.

requestBody.description: This request body allows the client to specify parameters that will be used to retrieve product information from the external agency. The content type is expected to be application/json, and the structure of the request must conform to the defined schema.

GetExternalAgencyProductServiceAgencyPro.description: The Request Body content represented as a JSON string for the GET operation on the product service agency.

GetExternalAgencyProductServiceAgencyPro.title: Product Service Agency Response

institutionId.description: The unique identifier for the financial institution.

agreementId.description: The identifier for the agreement associated with the institution.

bic.description: The Bank Identifier Code (BIC) for the financial institution.

countryCode.description: The ISO country code where the institution is located.

effectiveDate.description: The date when the agreement becomes effective.

recordStatus.description: The current status of the record (e.g., Active, Inactive).

version.description: The version number of the response.

updatedAt.description: The timestamp for when the record was last updated.

metadata.description: Additional metadata related to the response.

GetExternalAgencyProductServiceAgencyPro.description: This schema represents the response returned by the product service agency for a specific operation.

ResponseMetadata.title: Response Metadata

responseId.description: A unique identifier for the response.

correlationId.description: An identifier used for correlating requests and responses.

generatedAt.description: The timestamp when the response was generated.

processingRegion.description: The region where the processing of the request took place.

ResponseMetadata.description: This schema represents additional metadata associated with the response.

bearerAuth.description: Authentication scheme that utilizes JSON Web Tokens (JWT) for securing API requests. Clients must include a valid JWT in the Authorization header as a Bearer token.
